observed.source: Codex session rollout (CLI-recorded thread settings; not model-authored)

result.decision_rationale: The candidate-bound unit gate passed, and several publication and archive fixes are verified. The checkpoint still cannot pass. A different gate filter can clear unreadable evidence, resumed developer work can inherit an earlier invocation's effort observation, and a stale verdict can become visible after the controller has retired it without a correction. The permissions gate confirms the ambient-rule denial but does not establish a successful enrolled helper operation.

executed_verification: Read-only Git inspection confirmed HEAD at cad9f4fffb98dc434333ae1d2a3afc08c35b223f and the merge base at 79ab7af62729c2e329f267796780ce36fdffd07c. The supplied mission file matched its declared SHA-256.
The controller's unit receipt names H, exit code 0 and an unchanged worktree. The log matches the recorded SHA-256 and reports 152 tests discovered, 151 passed and one opt-in live smoke skipped.

The controller's permissions receipt also names H, exit code 0 and an unchanged worktree. Its log matches the recorded SHA-256. Both Claude launches completed. The production launch recorded a denial for the ambient status command, and the control recorded a tool result for that command.
inspected: The mission and owner addenda, AGENTS.md, operating guide, protocol, feature diff, controller, schemas, prompts, permission base, project and plan definitions, behavior tests and live-smoke fixture.
The fixed request, developer report, prior findings ledger, foreground transcript notice, and both candidate-bound gate receipts and logs.
limitations: The review used the read-only snapshot. Runtime conclusions about the behavior suite come from the controller's receipts and logs.
The foreground transcript notice supplies gate evidence only. The claimed separate live smoke run 15 has no candidate-bound output in the supplied inputs.

The damaged-envelope regression reaches an archive operation after a replacement intermediate pass. The archive-reference regression inspects committed records but constructs the partial publication state. Separate tests cover interruption during a multipart send and the ordinary final handoff.
required_gaps: A candidate-bound successful gate receipt from a real enrolled helper running under the headless permission profile.

Behavior evidence for unreadable gate identity, malformed rollout headers and payloads, resumed-invocation effort, uncertain verdict retirement, exhausted-budget status, and project-refresh recovery as specified in the findings.
source_inspection_only: The remaining failure paths below were traced through the candidate source. The passing unit log covers neighboring cases but does not demonstrate the requested outcomes for these triggers.

findings.actual: For an unreadable receipt, gate_status checks only the argument lists it can recover from other receipts. If the first and only run of filter A failed and its receipt became unreadable, a later successful B is the entire known set. The gate passes.
findings.blocking_rationale: The controller can accept a checkpoint with a required validation scope still failing.
findings.expected: Recovery establishes which run was lost and requires passing evidence for that scope.
findings.requested_correction: Persist the argument identity independently of the receipt body. Keep legacy damage with unknowable scope unresolved until the required coverage is established.
findings.requested_evidence: On H, run a failing A as its first run, truncate its receipt, then pass B. Show that report acceptance stays blocked and that a valid rerun of A recovers the gate.
findings.title: An unreadable first run can be cleared by a different filter
findings.trigger: A required gate accepts multiple argument lists and one receipt loses its entire JSON body.

findings.actual: The initial rollout lookup calls first.get before checking that the decoded header is an object. The sibling-rollout scan does the same. Within the selected rollout, a response_item with null payload is converted to an empty object and ignored. Malformed nested settings can also raise AttributeError outside attempt validation.
findings.blocking_rationale: Malformed provenance can escape bounded retries or be accepted alongside otherwise sufficient observations.
findings.expected: The parser validates the records it uses for identity, settings and tool dispatch, and records malformed selected provenance as a failed attempt.
findings.requested_correction: Validate headers during discovery and the required payload shape for each consumed record type. Route malformed selected records through invocation_problems.
findings.requested_evidence: Exercise a scalar first record, a malformed sibling header, and a null response-item payload in an otherwise valid selected rollout. Verify bounded handling, no accepted malformed attempt and unchanged round count.
findings.title: Rollout headers and payloads still escape structural validation
findings.trigger: Malformed JSON structure occurs outside the post-header cases covered by the new parser regression.

findings.actual: The probe uses the fixed agent-review-permission-probe identifier without enrolling it or declaring its probe gate. _tool_outcomes records is_error but classifies every returned result without a matching denial ID as ran. The regression explicitly classifies a refused, unregistered helper that way.
findings.blocking_rationale: The supplied log demonstrates permission isolation but cannot establish that the enrolled developer can complete its required helper operation.
findings.expected: The live observation shows the ambient denial and a successful controller operation for an enrolled headless developer.
findings.requested_correction: Retain the production/control isolation observation and supply the successful enrolled helper result. The existing live-smoke fixture can supply it if its candidate-bound output includes the actual helper receipt. Distinguish tool errors from successes in the probe output.
findings.requested_evidence: Provide H, CLI version and launch profile, plus a controller-written receipt identifying the fixture enrollment's candidate, gate and successful exit. Include the recorded permission decisions.
findings.title: The permissions probe counts a refused helper as having run
findings.trigger: The candidate-bound permissions log reports helper outcome ran.

findings.actual: Package relocation replaces developer-settings.json before saving the new digest and package root in state.json. A restart between those writes sees the old digest and stops at the tamper check before it reaches relocation recovery.
findings.blocking_rationale: An interrupted routine package switch leaves a valid enrollment unable to resume automatically.
findings.expected: The active permission file and its binding survive interruption as one recoverable transition.
findings.requested_correction: Publish the new settings and binding through a recoverable intent or an immutable settings file selected by the atomic state update. Preserve rejection of unrelated edits.
findings.requested_evidence: Interrupt relocation after the new settings are written and before the binding is saved. Resume through the launcher and verify the advertised helper path, active permission digest and rejection of independently altered settings.
findings.title: Interrupted permission relocation strands the enrollment
findings.trigger: A package-only upgrade changes the helper path and the controller exits while recomposing permissions.

findings.actual: reopen now clears the handoff coherently. The subsequent budget check raises UsageError, which guarded records only as a note. The persisted status is ACTIVE in develop, and the regression explicitly expects that state. A foreground developer again meets the status and phase conditions for push and verify.
findings.blocking_rationale: Exhaustion does not produce the required visible stop, and development helpers remain available before an extension.
findings.expected: Reopening retires the stale handoff and records a visible budget stop until an authorized extension.
findings.requested_correction: Persist and publish a budget-blocked or paused state when reopening consumes the available budget. Keep the subsequent extension resumable.
findings.requested_evidence: Use the guarded resume command after a last-round handoff moves. Check persisted status, public stop and helper refusal, then extend the budget and confirm development resumes.
findings.title: Reopening at the round cap leaves development active
findings.trigger: A superseded handoff is resumed without increasing an exhausted checkpoint budget.

findings.actual: ClaudeDeveloper.run obtains observed_effort by scanning the entire saved session. If the first invocation recorded high and a resumed invocation has no effort observation, the aggregate is still ['high']. The new empty-list check therefore accepts the resumed report.
findings.blocking_rationale: A checkpoint can be attributed to Opus high without an observation for the invocation that produced it.
findings.expected: Each headless invocation supplies affirmative effort provenance for its own work.
findings.requested_correction: Bind effort extraction to the current invocation's transcript records, including on resume. Preserve session history separately.
findings.requested_evidence: Use one session for two invocations. Record high only in the first and verify the second report cannot dispatch a review. Then demonstrate acceptance with a current high observation.
findings.title: Resumed work can borrow effort evidence from an earlier invocation
findings.trigger: A long-running mission resumes its saved Claude session and the new invocation lacks readable effort metadata.

findings.actual: retire_verdict and retire_receipts treat one absent listing as zero visible parts even when posting_since records uncertain delivery. They mark the publication superseded. Later settlement skips it, so the original comment can appear without its correction or authenticated archive reference.
findings.blocking_rationale: A stale pass or owner-review receipt can remain publicly visible as current.
findings.expected: Uncertain delivery remains recoverable through retirement. Any delivered stale part is identified and corrected.
findings.requested_correction: Carry unresolved POST intents through verdict and receipt retirement. Require reconciliation or explicit resolution before considering retirement complete.
findings.requested_evidence: Store a verdict or receipt, lose its response, hide it from the listing, and move the head. Restore visibility after retirement begins and verify one original, a visible correction and the recovered publication reference.
findings.title: Retirement drops an uncertain verdict before GitHub shows it
findings.trigger: A verdict becomes stale after a lost POST response while the comment listing still omits the stored part.

findings.actual: activate replaces the pinned project configuration, but invalidates preserved reviews only when the workflow fingerprint changes. That fingerprint explicitly excludes projects/. A refresh that changes the repository instructions supplied to the reviewer can therefore retain a validated pass or ready handoff produced under the old instructions.
findings.blocking_rationale: The controller can reuse a verdict after a material review input changes.
findings.expected: A change to the effective review contract invalidates results that depended on the previous contract.
findings.requested_correction: Bind reviews to the relevant pinned project configuration and apply the existing retirement and rereview path when a refresh changes review inputs.
findings.requested_evidence: Preserve a validated result, refresh the project's instruction list without changing controller code, and resume. Verify the old pass cannot advance and that the fresh request contains the new instructions. Cover an existing ready handoff as well.
findings.title: Project refresh can retain a review of the previous contract
findings.trigger: An owner activates a project-only change while a validated result or final handoff exists.

findings.actual: gate_status groups receipts by complete argv, then validates every group's latest receipt against the current gate declaration. After refresh changes a gate's base command, the old group fails that check forever on H. A successful run of the replacement command creates a different group and cannot clear it.
findings.blocking_rationale: An owner-approved validation change can make the unchanged candidate impossible to qualify through the documented rerun path.
findings.expected: The refreshed definition requires fresh evidence and can be satisfied by running the new gate on H.
findings.requested_correction: Bind receipts to a gate-definition version. Preserve old evidence as history and apply argument-list supersession within the active definition.
findings.requested_evidence: Pass a gate on H, refresh its base argv, confirm fresh evidence is required, and pass the replacement gate on the same H. Verify acceptance succeeds while old receipts remain intact.
findings.title: A refreshed gate command cannot supersede its old receipts
findings.trigger: activate --refresh-project changes the command for a required gate that already ran on the current candidate.

findings.actual: missing_publications skips every final- key except the named active receipt. That also skips the posted final-status-…-retired correction. If that correction disappears or is altered, remote status can still certify A2 while the public receipt for A remains uncorrected.
findings.blocking_rationale: The current handoff depends on a retirement correction that the controller never rechecks.
findings.expected: The public correction that distinguishes a superseded receipt from the current one remains authenticated at handoff and on remote status checks.
findings.requested_correction: Limit the old-receipt exemption to actual receipt keys. Authenticate required retirement and supersession corrections as substantive publications.
findings.requested_evidence: Extend the successful A-to-A2 recovery fixture by altering or removing A's posted retirement correction. Verify remote status and resume detect the incomplete public handoff.
findings.title: Handoff checks skip the correction that retires an older receipt
findings.trigger: The public retirement correction is lost after recovery has created a new handoff receipt.

prior_finding_assessments.rationale: The named receipt must exist in posted state and its nonempty part inventory must cover 1 through N with a consistent total. Each part is then authenticated against the PR. The candidate regression exercises empty and shortened inventories.
The readable-argv case now recovers correctly. A fully unreadable first run still has no independently recoverable argument identity, so passing another filter can clear it.
The parser rejects the tested malformed records after a valid header and detects conflicting session IDs. Header discovery and nested payload access still bypass the new checks.

Archive construction now takes comment IDs and URLs from the carried parts of each publication. Original and historical renderings have distinct committed envelopes. The unit log confirms the archive-reference and interrupted-multipart tests passed.

The supplied live log establishes the ambient denial and completed control launch. Its helper outcome includes error results, and the probe creates no registered enrollment. The reported separate smoke run lacks a supplied receipt.

The archive preserves the public text, expected digest and publication references for an invalidated damaged envelope. The regression reaches the previously failing archive operation and checks that damage to an accepted envelope still blocks its archival.

Window expiry now pauses with the send intent preserved. The stale-listing regression verifies that restarting does not automatically issue a second POST. R6-F1 concerns what happens when that uncertain publication must be retired.
An uninterrupted package relocation now aligns the advertised commands and permission file. Interruption between replacing the file and saving its binding still prevents resume.
The null-handoff failure is fixed and a later extension works. The intervening exhausted enrollment persists as ACTIVE and exposes development helpers without a visible budget stop.
The body-edit failure regression reaches A2 through resume and verifies a posted correction for A and one current receipt. R6-F4 covers continued verification of that correction.
An empty effort list now blocks. On resume, the list comes from the entire session, so an earlier high observation can conceal missing evidence for the current invocation.

summary.delivered_behavior: The controller implements fixed-candidate review, explicit model launch settings, schema validation, writer locks, bounded attempts, durable publication and transcript-only archives. This round improves receipt inventory checking, historical envelope references, damaged-envelope archival and ordinary handoff retirement.
pending_later_phase_work: Setup-final covers the complete workflow guide, reviewed installation and permissions, Black Tentacles binding and start command, and the setup acceptance report.
remaining_owner_review: Final operational acceptance and any merge or release decision remain with the owner after the final checkpoint.
summary.scope_reviewed: Intermediate controller-core checkpoint for draft PR #1 at the fixed candidate, including all eleven pending findings and the WF04–WF10 and WF12 behavior contract.
